recent.quoted_text: There isn't a Trevor Lawrence or Andrew Luck in this draft but the #Jets winning dumb ass games to finish 5-13 after shitting the bed most of this year is what we are all prepared for. Winning the next two weeks will be Frank Gore beating the Rams level hilarious

recent.text: My man - Go and enjoy the weather, watch a few David Bailey sacks, GW grabs and have peace of mind with either result. #Jets are going to have three top 12 picks, probably two top 6 picks and a new HC next year.

recent.quoted_text: @BadlandsTOJ I’m right with you, @JCaporoso. I’ve been a Jets fan since 1969. There have been many more losing season than winning, so at this point I’m numb to it.
